profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Change Healthcare
profile.summary: Experienced software engineer in building complex, robust and scalable systems for enterprises. Key contributor in all phases of software development lifecycle, including business analysis, coding, testing, implementation, documentation and maintenance.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Design and develop a complex microservices systems using event-driven architecture for high scalability.
• Use CQRS pattern and service bus to support independent scalability and multiple read models.
• Deploy container on AWS Fargate and run CICD pipeline on Azure DevOps.
• Build complex testing module for consumer-driven contract tests and component tests.
• Teach and advocate the use of Kafka for data intensive application.
Skills: .Net Core, Event driven, AWS ECS, Azure, Microservices, Docker, PostgreSQL, TDD/BDD, Gherkin

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Lead the research, design, development, documentation, testing, implementation and maintenance of the company’s proprietary system. 
• Design and develop a large-scale, high performance system with Kafka that automates global manufacturing of optical media. 
• Design and develop a web application of high traffic volume for global bidding and procurement.
• Design and develop an interactive web application for monitoring the manufacturing process.
• Maintain a team of 5 software developers. 
Tools:  Kafka, C#/C++, Python, Java, JavaScript, Node.js, SQL Server/MySQL, Agile Methodology

positions.title: Senior Analyst Programmer
positions.description:
• Led the research, design, development, documentation, testing, implementation and maintenance of four major systems for various departments in the bank. 
• Collected, analyzed and documented business requirements. 
• Developed a scalable and efficient anti-money laundering (AML) detection system, which reduces daily human workload for up to 5 hours and improves accuracy by 20%.
• Developed a high performance document generating systems, which reduces daily processing time for 3 hours and increase accuracy by 30%.
• Developed a real time matching system for instant trading info matching, which saves daily human workload by 2 hours and improves accuracy by 20%.
• Developed a loan management system, which protect customer data and reduce daily human workload by 2 hours. 

Tools:  C#/C++, JavaScript, SQL server 2008, Waterfall SDLC

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed Lynx, the enterprise’s next generation of global editorial system.
Developed a distributed back-end in SOA model.
Developed a highly interactive and content intensive web application for editorial planning activities

Tools:  C#, ASP.net, JavaScript, jQuery, SQL Server 2008, Agile Methodology

positions.title: Business Analyst
positions.description:
Analyzed securities trading patterns of customers and helped develop business strategies.
Designed and developed a securities trading system for global stock markets.
Monitored securities trading activities and identify violations of bank policies.

Tools: PHP 5, JavaScript, SQL, C++
